headline: Congress approved appointing Michael Lynton as a citizen regent on the Smithsonian Institution's governing Board of Regents.
what_it_does: This joint resolution names Michael Lynton as one of the citizen regents on the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian is a federal museum and research group, and its Board of Regents oversees it. The summary does not describe any duties, money, or rules beyond the appointment itself.
when_it_takes_effect: The measure was enacted on September 29, 2014.
